name: A Witchling's Gambit
source:
When a young witch plays a game with a demon for magic, she gets into a bigger mess than she bargained for.

[From [url=https://robertwrites.itch.io/a-witchlings-gambit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一位年轻的女巫与恶魔玩魔法游戏时，她陷入了比她预想的更大的混乱。

[来自[url=https://robertwrites.itch.io/a-witchlings-gambit]Itch.io[/url]]
